coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Two of the six ground-truth variable items fully match: standard versus fused Adam implementations, and gradient graph complexity measured through node counts, edge counts, and visual clarity.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output varies network architecture and unrolling steps rather than holding architecture and training configuration fixed. Some optimizer hyperparameters are controlled, but the complete training configuration is not. Omniglot and other standard meta-learning datasets are omitted. TorchViz is used to render all conditions rather than treating TorchViz versus TorchOpt as a visualization-tool independent variable. Additional conditions and metrics extend beyond the specified design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The required conclusion that operation fusion reduces gradient graph complexity and produces simpler visualizations is missing from conclusion_output, although a similar expected outcome appears within design_output.
